body:
Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#102

## Summary
- Added a reusable `YouTubeUploader` that builds YouTube video metadata, appends `#short` when the Short option is enabled, starts a resumable YouTube Data API upload session, uploads recording blobs in chunks, and reports progress.
- Added Google sign-in and YouTube metadata/upload modals to the example app, with `Upload to YouTube` next to both browser download and Electron save actions.
- Fixed OAuth origin handling for desktop and browser usage: direct `file://` authorization uses a localhost handoff, and Electron now prefers the stable origin `http://localhost:8080` so users can register one Authorized JavaScript origin in Google Cloud Console.
- Improved `401 invalid_client` recovery: the modal validates malformed IDs, explains the exact Authorized JavaScript origin requirement, and includes an `OAuth Setup` button that opens Google Cloud's OAuth client page while showing/copying the current origin.
- Opted GitHub Actions JavaScript actions into the Node.js 24 runtime to address the Node 20 deprecation warning reported from the build log.
- Added issue-102 case-study notes, fresh issue/PR/review/CI snapshots, timeline/root-cause analysis, official API research, solution options, and UI screenshot evidence.

## Verification
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm test -- --runInBand`
- `npm run build`
- `node --check electron/main.js`
- `node --check examples/youtube-upload.js`
- `git diff --check`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/youtube-upload-ui.cy.js --config baseUrl=http://localhost:8080` (6 passing)
- GitHub Actions `Build Portable EXE` on latest commit: pending for `8aabe4c`

## Screenshot
![YouTube upload form](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-102-ea27a4a1da11/docs/case-studies/issue-102/youtube-upload-form.png?raw=true)

## Research Sources
- Google Identity Services token model: https://developers.google.com/identity/oauth2/web/guides/use-token-model
- Google Identity Services OAuth client setup: https://developers.google.com/identity/gsi/web/guides/get-google-api-clientid
- Google Account Authorization JavaScript API: https://developers.google.com/identity/oauth2/web/reference/js-reference
- Google client-side OAuth `invalid_client` and origin mismatch guidance: https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/javascript-implicit-flow
- Google OAuth client management: https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/6158849
- YouTube `videos.insert`: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos/insert
- YouTube resumable upload protocol: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/guides/using_resumable_upload_protocol
- YouTube video resource fields: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos
- YouTube Shorts upload help: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/10059070
- YouTube hashtag help: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6390658
- GitHub Actions Node.js 20 runner deprecation: https://github.blog/changelog/2025-09-19-deprecation-of-node-20-on-github-actions-runners/
